desc: Parse input: read K, S, T from stdin; strip newlines.
Quick reject: if abs(len(S)-len(T)) > K, print No and exit.

Implement banded Levenshtein DP: iterate over rows of S, maintaining only columns j with |i-j| ≤ K, using two arrays of size 2K+3 with offset mapping; handle insert/delete/replace costs and boundary conditions (out-of-band cells treated as infinity).
Early exit: if the minimum value in a row's band exceeds K, print No immediately.
After processing, check whether the cell (|S|, |T|) is within band and ≤ K; print Yes or No accordingly.
Wrap in main() with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), and verify edge cases: equal strings, K=0 (though constraints say K≥1), single-character strings.
Verify correctness of band indexing and edge cases by manual trace or brute-force comparison against full DP on small random inputs.
